items.prompt: Why should a valid binary Add A decode not immediately mutate an account position?
items.modelAnswer: It is an outbound market-data order-book event, not a personal execution confirmation. Need correct source/session/sequence/schema/directory mapping, duplicate/gap policy and book rules. Account changes require source-bound execution identity/units/reconciliation and proper authority, not a feed Add event.

criteria.text: Distinguishes market-data book event from account fill.
Avoids deriving execution/authority from decoder success.
